axis: studio = (-x, z, y) of blender; Blender front -Y = Studio front -Z
units: studs; the model is at final size, import 1:1 and do not scale
sides: L/R are the dog's own left/right; its left is Blender +X = Studio -X
origin: all positions are relative to the model origin = the ground point under the body pivot (Blender world origin)
texture_note: one shared atlas; every MeshPart uses the same TextureID (Common rarity: no Neon, no glow)
rest_rotation: every part has identity rotation relative to the model at rest
rig: one Motor6D per part: Part0 = joint_parent, Part1 = the part, C0/C1 placed at the part's pivot

Retriever_Body.suggested_motion: root part: bob up/down in Studio Y and a small roll about Studio Z while running

Retriever_Head.suggested_motion: nod = pitch about Studio X, tilt = roll about Studio Z, look = yaw about Studio Y, all through the neck joint

Retriever_EarL.pivot_is: ear root on the skull (flop pivot)
Retriever_EarL.suggested_motion: flop = rotate about Studio Z (front-back axis) through the ear root; child of the head

Retriever_EarR.pivot_is: ear root on the skull (flop pivot)
Retriever_EarR.suggested_motion: flop = rotate about Studio Z (front-back axis) through the ear root; child of the head

Retriever_LegFL.suggested_motion: trot = swing about Studio X (side-to-side axis) through the shoulder

Retriever_LegFR.suggested_motion: trot = swing about Studio X (side-to-side axis) through the shoulder

Retriever_LegBL.suggested_motion: trot = swing about Studio X (side-to-side axis) through the hip

Retriever_LegBR.suggested_motion: trot = swing about Studio X (side-to-side axis) through the hip

Retriever_Tail.pivot_is: tail root (wag = turn about the vertical axis)
Retriever_Tail.suggested_motion: wag = yaw about Studio Y through the tail root (lift = pitch about Studio X)

Retriever_CrystalTag.pivot_is: tag ring on the collar (swing pivot)
Retriever_CrystalTag.suggested_motion: dangle = swing about Studio X through the ring on the collar (lags the body)
